purpose: Observed-state engineering and retrospective source replay; no model fitting or clinical forecasting
baseline_clock: Prior 28 UTC decision-calendar days; current decision day and latest measurement-end day excluded; only readings available by the decision
baseline_summary: Equal-weight mean of daily means, separately by patient, origin, channel, context and device/source series
source_device_identity: unknown; kit/stream is a source-series identifier, not a physical device identifier
scope: No imputations, risk scores, treatment recommendations, counterfactual effects or outcome annotations in prediction state
